tests.name: cbor_float_parsing
tests.intent: Verify that CBOR single-precision floats are parsed and emitted correctly via binary_reader.

tests.name: cbor_double_parsing
tests.intent: Verify that CBOR double-precision floats are parsed and emitted correctly via binary_reader.

tests.name: msgpack_float_parsing
tests.intent: Verify that MessagePack float formats utilize the new number parsing path correctly.

tests.name: msgpack_double_parsing
tests.intent: Verify that MessagePack double formats parse correctly.

tests.name: ubjson_float_parsing
tests.intent: Verify that UBJSON float types parse correctly.

tests.name: ubjson_double_parsing
tests.intent: Verify that UBJSON double types parse correctly.

tests.name: bjdata_float_parsing
tests.intent: Verify that BJData float type parsing functions properly.

tests.name: bjdata_double_parsing
tests.intent: Verify that BJData double type parsing functions properly.

tests.name: cbor_special_floats
tests.intent: Verify parsing of special float values like infinity and NaN in CBOR.

tests.name: cbor_negative_zero
tests.intent: Verify parsing of negative zero float values in CBOR.

tests.name: cbor_stream_float_parsing
tests.intent: Verify parsing CBOR floats from a std::istringstream to exercise the stream adapter and always-inline get().

tests.name: cbor_stream_double_parsing
tests.intent: Verify parsing CBOR doubles from a std::istringstream.

tests.name: msgpack_stream_float_parsing
tests.intent: Verify parsing MessagePack floats from a stream.

tests.name: roundtrip_cbor_float
tests.intent: Verify roundtrip serialization and deserialization of a float using CBOR format.

tests.name: roundtrip_cbor_double
tests.intent: Verify roundtrip serialization and deserialization of a double using CBOR format.

tests.name: roundtrip_msgpack_float
tests.intent: Verify roundtrip of float using MessagePack.

tests.name: roundtrip_ubjson_float
tests.intent: Verify roundtrip of float using UBJSON.

tests.name: cbor_array_float_parsing
tests.intent: Verify parsing of arrays containing floats in CBOR.

tests.name: binary_reader_integer_swap_untouched
tests.intent: Verify that integer binary reader path still functions properly alongside new float byte swaps.

tests.name: cbor_truncated_float_error
tests.intent: Verify proper exception handling when a CBOR float input is truncated.
